title: Shortest Unsorted Continuous Subarray
summary: Given an integer array nums, identify the shortest continuous subarray that, when sorted, will result in the entire array being sorted in non-decreasing order.
statement: Given an integer array nums, identify the shortest continuous subarray that, when sorted, will result in the entire array being sorted in non-decreasing order. Return the length of this subarray.
constraints: Return the shortest continuous window which, when sorted nondecreasingly, makes all nums sorted; return zero if already sorted.
reference_solution:
def shortest_unsorted_window(nums):
    ordered=sorted(nums)
    left=0
    while left<len(nums) and nums[left]==ordered[left]:left+=1
    right=len(nums)-1
    while right>=left and nums[right]==ordered[right]:right-=1
    return right-left+1

def shortest_unsorted_window(nums):
    ordered=sorted(nums)
    left=0
    while left<len(nums) and nums[left]==ordered[left]:left+=1
